pages.text: A $(thing)Resonance Core$() floods power through connected $(thing)Lumen Conduits$() (dead → dim → active) and opens the $(thing)Ancient Doors$() they reach. $(thing)Lumen Relays$() bridge gaps in the network.

A powered $(thing)Gravity Lens$() lifts entities in the column above it. A dead city's $(thing)Dormant Light Engine$() can be restored with a looted $(o)resonance core fragment$() — waking the network. Cores and lenses can be rebuilt from looted fragments.
